title: Vector Clocks Remix
tagline: Compare four causality-tracking strategies by how their metadata grows with system concurrency.

curves.label: Scalar Lamport
curves.code: clock = 0; onEvent(){ clock = clock + 1; send(clock); } onReceive(ts){ clock = Math.max(clock, ts) + 1; }
curves.name: Scalar Lamport

curves.label: Full Vector Clocks
curves.code: vc = Array(k).fill(0); onEvent(i){ vc[i]++; } onReceive(j, incoming){ for(p=0;p<k;p++) vc[p]=Math.max(vc[p], incoming[p]); }
curves.name: Full Vector Clocks
